explicit_facts: The study is a multicenter study on Fabry disease.
The goal is to identify comparable quantitative MRI measures between centers.
Native T1 is the main candidate.
T2 is not available everywhere and remains exploratory.
LGE is only partially available and will not be primary.
negations_or_constraints: T2 will not be available everywhere.
LGE is not available fully and will not be primary.
ownership_or_epistemic_notes: User states the study design and MRI measure statuses.
relations: Native T1 is related to study candidate measures.
T2 availability limitation is related to its exploratory status.
LGE partial availability is related to its exclusion as a primary measure.
state_summary: Preparation of a multicenter study on Fabry disease aiming to identify comparable quantitative MRI measures across centers, evaluating native T1 as the primary candidate, ECV as conditional, T2 as exploratory due to limited availability, and LGE as partial and non-primary.
temporal_context: Current preparation phase of the multicenter study.
